probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Riflesso Menu Milan 00:00 Overview Buy Riflesso [email protected] Instagram Via Tortona, Milan Work Artists Films Archive Journal About Contact A small studio for photographers who still print their work Riflesso started in 2014 as a rented room on Via Tortona and two photographers sharing a lighting kit. Today we represent five artists, run their productions and open the room to anyone who needs good daylight. The studio on Via Tortona, 180 square metres with daylight from three sides What we do Four ways to work with the studio 01 Representation We look after five photographers: their bookings, their estimates and the long conversations before a shoot is confirmed. 02 Production Casting, locations, crew, permits and catering. One producer stays with each job from the first call to delivery. 03 Studio hire The room is open to other photographers by the day or half day, with lights, backdrops and an assistant if you need one. 04 Licensing Images from the archive and from personal series can be licensed for editorial and commercial use, quoted within two days.
